integrity: The infinite statement is proved by a complete split on whether the hub is initially selected and by identifying every possible first force when it is not. The enumerator then follows from the published path criterion and an explicit four-state boundary automaton. The standalone verifier independently simulates every subset in a finite range and checks the claimed coefficients. The elementary scalar value is not presented as the novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the ordinary undirected fan \(F_m=K_1\vee P_m\) for \(m\ge3\).
The exhaustive verifier covers \(3\le m\le10\) and corroborates but does not prove the infinite theorem.
The claim does not extend to directed fans, generalized fans with multiple universal vertices, or other zero forcing variants.
A poorly indexed source using an uncommon alias for fan graphs could remain undetected.
title: Zero forcing polynomial of fan graphs
